listen_addresses.description: IP addresses or hostnames on which pgpool-II listens for client connections. Use '*' to listen on all interfaces.

port.description: Port number pgpool-II listens on for client connections.

unix_socket_directories.description: Directory path for Unix domain socket. Used for local client connections.

num_init_children.description: Number of child processes to handle client requests. Set higher for more concurrent clients.

max_pool.description: Maximum number of connections per child process to each PostgreSQL backend. Avoid exceeding backend's max_connections.

backends.description: List of backend PostgreSQL servers. Each server must have a unique hostname, port, and status.

hostname.description: Hostname or IP address of the backend PostgreSQL server.

port.description: Port number of the backend PostgreSQL server.

weight.description: Load balancing weight (higher = more connections routed).

data_directory.description: Data directory on the backend server (used for health checks and failover).

num_backends.description: Number of backend servers defined in `backends`. Must match the list length.

load_balance_mode.description: Enable or disable SQL load balancing. Must be enabled for read scaling.

health_check_period.description: Interval (seconds) between health checks to backends. Set 0 to disable.

health_check_timeout.description: Timeout (seconds) for a health check connection. Lower values detect failures faster.

failover_on_backend_error.description: If true, pgpool-II automatically promotes a standby if a backend fails health check.

log_connections.description: Log all client connections (for auditing or troubleshooting).

log_hostname.description: Include client hostname in log entries (requires reverse DNS lookups).

log_statement.description: Log all SQL statements (impact: high disk usage). Use for debugging only.

log_per_node_statement.description: Log SQL statements per backend node (useful for multi-tier replication).

authentication_timeout.description: Maximum time (seconds) to complete client authentication.

ssl.description: Enable SSL/TLS encryption for client and/or backend connections.

delay_threshold.description: Delay threshold (in bytes) for standby lag. Queries to standbys are blocked if lag exceeds this. Set 0 for no check.

ignore_missing_postmaster_parameter.description: If true, skip health check failures when `pg_control` parameter is missing (helpful for older Postgres versions).

memory_cache_enabled.description: Enable query result caching in shared memory for read queries.

use_watchdog.description: Enable Watchdog for high availability (synchronizes pgpool nodes via Pacemaker-like protocol).

watchdog_hostname.description: Hostname/IP of this pgpool instance when Watchdog is enabled.

watchdog_port.description: Port for Watchdog communication between pgpool instances.

watchdog_interval.description: Heartbeat interval (seconds) for Watchdog health monitoring.
